title: Engineering sync: Handoff brief — 2026-04-15
summary: Weekly cross-team leadership handoff focused on observability runway, SLO adjustments, and a short deconflict of overlapping rollout windows. Emphasis on immediate action items for runbooks, dashboard ownership, and two small tactical fixes to reduce alert noise.
body:
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Arjun Rao, Priya Nair, Ethan Wallace, Sofia Martinez, Lina Park, plus notes from Simon (absent) shared ahead

Agenda:
- Quick metrics snapshot and 99th pct latency trends
- Open action review from last week
- Runbook coverage gaps for Dedicated rollout in EU-west-3
- Alert tuning spikes: alerts firing on cache warmup after release
- Cross-team schedule conflicts for planned infra maintenance (4/20–4/22)
- AOB: telemetry tagging inconsistency, upcoming on-call rotations

Notes:
1) Metrics snapshot:
- Observability team ran a quick query: median inference request latency steady, 95th up 6% week-over-week, 99th seeing a few regressions tied to long-tail GPU queue times. Root-cause hypothesis: micro-bursts from background batch jobs + uneven autoscaler behavior on some Dedicated pools.
- Cost signal: token cost per 1k increased slightly due to more prompt reissue from retry logic in the client library (PR referenced below).

2) Open actions review:
- PR #612 (infra) merged, but needs a follow-up to add defensive metrics (Ethan).
- Runbook coverage: two endpoints missing clear playbooks for EU-west-3 (Priya to own).
- SLO postmortem draft updated; action to add a short executive summary (Maya).

3) Runbook / Playbooks:
- Observability audit found 4 runbooks with stale contact lists and 2 with step ordering that assumes staffing we no longer have. We agreed to triage into: critical (fix this week), moderate (next sprint), low (backlog).
- Critical: Dedicated capacity degradation playbook, data-plane fallback steps for private deployments. Priya & Lina will pair and deliver updated steps + contact refresh by 2026-04-19.

4) Alert noise & tuning:
- Several alerts were firing during staged releases due to cache warmups and KV-cache repopulation. Proposed quick wins: add a short suppression window for specific alert IDs during rollout and add a new telemetry tag (release_id) to the alerting stream.
- Decision: implement suppression + tag in next deploy pipeline for canaries only (to avoid hiding real regressions). Arjun to own the pipeline change; ETA 2026-04-18.

5) Maintenance window deconflict (4/20–4/22):
- Platform-engineering and Serving-runtime both scheduled infra upgrades that may impact latency. We flagged three customer-impacting flows that should not be run in parallel.
- Action: create a simple matrix with blackout windows per team and publish to #eng-all by EOD 2026-04-16. Sofia to coordinate with release engineering and calendar owners.

6) Telemetry & tagging consistency:
- We still see inconsistently named telemetry keys across hosted and private SDKs (prompt_id vs promptId). This makes trace linking brittle. Decided to standardize on snake_case telemetry keys for server-side emitted fields; SDK teams will accept temporary adapter layers. Lina to open an RFC and Michelle (DX) will review. Target RFC draft by 2026-04-23.

7) On-call/rotation note:
- Upcoming rotation has two new engineers; runbook shadowing required. Priya to schedule 1-hour onboarding for next two rotations.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Do we want a stricter SLO for 99th latency for Dedicated customers (cost vs SLA tradeoff)? Engineering leadership to discuss offline and bring recommendation next meeting.
- How to formalize the suppression pattern so product owners are aware of missing signals during canaries? (parked for policy doc)

Decisions made:
- Temporary suppression window for release-related alerts (canary-only) — Arjun will implement this week.
- Prioritize runbook fixes for Dedicated EU-west-3 and private deployments as critical — Priya & Lina pairing.
- Publish maintenance blackout matrix to #eng-all before 2026-04-17 EOD.

Context / references discussed:
- Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/612 (adds defensive metrics)
- Confluence runbook index: OBS-Runbook-Home (link above)
- Incident JIRA: JIRA-2345 (99th latency regression post-release)

Tone / style notes (internal):
- These are working notes. Expect scratches, TODOs, and references to Slack threads rather than polished prose. If any follow-ups are needed for an external audience, we’ll generate a separate brief.

Next meeting: 2026-04-22, 10:00am PT — same format, focus on runbook completions and post-suppression noise analysis.
action_items: Arjun Rao: implement canary-only alert suppression + release_id telemetry tag (ETA 2026-04-18)
Priya Nair & Lina Park: update Dedicated EU-west-3 runbooks and refresh contact lists (ETA 2026-04-19)
Ethan Wallace: add defensive metrics to post-merge follow-up for PR #612 (ETA 2026-04-20)
Sofia Martinez: coordinate blackout matrix with release engineering and publish to #eng-all (ETA 2026-04-16)
Maya Chen: add executive summary to SLO postmortem (ETA 2026-04-19)
Lina Park: draft RFC for telemetry key standardization (ETA 2026-04-23)
Priya Nair: schedule runbook shadowing/on-call onboarding (ETA 2026-04-18)
